name: Rabin-Karp Algorithm
description: String searching algorithm using rolling hash to find pattern in text in O(n+m) average time.
aim: Use polynomial rolling hash to quickly identify potential pattern matches, then verify with direct comparison.
howItWorks: Compute rolling hash of text windows
Compare hashes O(1); verify character-by-character on match
Roll hash: remove leftmost char, add new rightmost char

time.worstCase: All positions are spurious hash collisions

whenToUse: Multiple pattern search in same text
alternatives: Boyer-Moore — faster in practice for long patterns
